topic: What margin allocation strategies ensure reliable entanglement distribution across fluctuating atmospheric fading channels with high photon loss?
response: To ensure reliable entanglement distribution across fluctuating atmospheric fading channels with high photon loss, post-selection and entanglement distillation techniques can be employed. These strategies involve selecting a subset of channel transmittance distribution with high transmission coefficient to contribute to the resultant post-selected state and key rate.
reference_context: The provided context states that satellite-based communication channels suffer from high uplink losses (25-30 dB) and single downlink channels have losses of 5-10 dB. Post-selection and entanglement distillation techniques are introduced as methods to improve entanglement distribution and quantum key rate, particularly in the presence of atmospheric fading.
